title: 2 Kids Left Home Alone For Hours Almost Ends In Tragedy (Police Bodycam)
description:
On April 30th, 2025 . Police respond after 2 kids are left home alone and almost ended in tragedy after mom leaves them to go to work. This is body-cam footage of the events.
